messages.subject: A theoretical question
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am trying to understand the INLA methodology better, but am having some trouble. In particular, I am not able to show that equation (3) in the JRSS 'B' paper is equivalent to the Laplace approximation in Section 4 of the Tierney & Kadane (1986) paper.

If I understand correctly, then if I try to do a Laplace approximation of \pi(\theta | y), then I should arrive at the expression in equation (3). However, I am not clear how to introduce the Gaussian approximation in the denominator.

Could someone please guide me along?

Best regards,
Vik
